claims.claimText: Yale's September2023 Provost guidance says not to enter confidential, legally restricted, moderate-risk or high-risk Yale data into an AI tool. The current institutional directory separately lists Clarity for High-risk data with a special ePHI environment and DUA restrictions, while Radiate web search is listed for Low-risk data. It lists Copilot Chat Web as Moderate and Work as High, Gemini and NotebookLM as Moderate, and Claude Enterprise as High with a special ePHI environment. These platform classifications must be read with each service's access restrictions and applicable data agreements; they do not resolve authorization for every dataset.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: 1.    Protect Yale’s confidential information and your own. Do not enter confidential or legally restricted data or any data that Yale’s data classification policy identifies as moderate or high-risk into an AI tool.  If you are not sure whether you should share certain data, please review Yale’s data classification policy.
